UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION
MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,
Plaintiff,
Case No. 1:26-cv-02331
V.
KATIE HALL, individually;
NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED
CHILDREN;
META PLATFORMS, INC.;
and JOHN/JANE DOES 1-6,
Defendants.
PLAINTIFF'S MOTION FOR REFERRAL TO AN EARLY SETTLEMENT
CONFERENCE
Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine moves under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 16(a)(5) and
16(c)(2)(I), and Local Civil Rule 83.6(A), (C), and (G), for referral of this action to an early
settlement conference before a United States magistrate judge designated by the Court. A
Memorandum in Support and Proposed Order accompany this Motion.
Given the number and scope of the pending proceedings, an early settlement
conference may permit the parties to explore resolution before further judicial resources are
committed
Plaintiff is willing to participate in a court-assisted settlement conference.
Plaintiff requests that the designated magistrate judge determine the conference's scheduling,
format, attendance requirements, and any settlement submissions.
1

3.
This Motion requests no stay or extension of any deadline and does not withdraw
or modify any pending motion, objection, or hearing request.
Plaintiff waives oral argument on this Motion only and requests that the Court
direct its submission and determination on the papers under Local Civil Rules 7(E) and 7(J) and
Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 78(b).
WHEREFORE, Plaintiff respectfully requests that the Court refer this action to an early
settlement conference before a United States magistrate judge designated by the Court.
Date: November 3, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847
Alexandria, Virginia 22307
(407) 794-6503
jayballentine@protonmail.com
2

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
I certify that on November 3, 2026, I submitted the following documents to the Clerk of
Court for filing through the Court's Electronic Document Submission System (EDSS):
Plaintiff's Motion for Referral to an Early Settlement Conference, with its
Certificate of Service, Local Civil Rule 83.1(N) Certification, and Generative Artificial
Intelligence Disclosure and Citation Certification;
Memorandum in Support of Plaintiff's Motion for Referral to an Early Settlement
Conference;
[Proposed] Order; and
Notice of Waiver of Oral Argument and Request for Submission on the Papers.
Counsel of record for Defendants National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, Katie
Hall, and Meta Platforms, Inc. are registered users of the Court's Case Management/Electronic
Case Filing (CM/ECF) system. Upon the Clerk's docketing of the submission, the CM/ECF system
will transmit a Notice of Electronic Filing to each of them, and service will be made through that
means under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 5(b)(2)(E). EDSS submission is not itself service.
Date: November 3, 2026
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
